newsitem.title: USA: LaserSight unit wins vision care pact.
newsitem.headline: LaserSight unit wins vision care pact.

text.p: LaserSight Inc said Wednesday its MEC Health Care Inc subsidiary had signed an agreement to provide managed vision care to commercial and Medicaid enrollees of HealthPlan Southeast of Tallahassee, Fla.
HealthPlan Southeast will have combined enrollment in its commercial and Medicaid plans of about 160,000 by the end of the year, LaserSight said.

Separately, MEC Health said it had been selected to provide total vision care for the new Medicare risk product being marketed by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Maryland and Blue Cross and Blue Shield of the National Capital area.
Financial terms of the contracts were not announced.
LaserSight is a holding company with four operating subsidiaries. Its shares were down 1/16 at 5-5/8.
